tuned_on_dev: inherits devansh-profile-faithful: regulation rules, writer style rules, ranker criteria, implicit-obligation patterns and the profile prompt were written while looking at the dev case

NEW: excluding clauses cited at 'Table' / 'Figure' / 'Appendix' labels was decided from an error analysis of devansh-profile-faithful's dev output (42 table / figure / appendix-cited requirements, 1 matched; the dev experts cite no table, figure or appendix label). During the same analysis the citation-label counts of the holdout answer key and of the previous holdout predictions were also printed (0 of 94 expected table citations; 2 of 71 table/figure/appendix predictions matched across both cases), so holdout-acpe is not fully unseen for this one rule
NEW: the restatement-merge prompt was written once, after reading dev false positives that repeat one limit in the main text, a table and an appendix; it was not iterated against any score

NEW (v3): adding Claude's regulation picks was decided after the platform showed the keyword rules missed 2 of 7 regulations on heldout-front-bumper (regulation recall 71.4%; no answer key seen). The 'product itself, no whole-vehicle approvals' instruction was written after seeing Claude's unrestricted picks on the three specs (it added cyber security / software update / crash-test regulations on ACPE and the bumper); it names categories of regulations, not products, and was run once

NEW (v4): the rationale skip, pair merge and subject check were chosen after reading v3's bumper output (no answer key exists; only its platform score P 33.9 / R 75.0 was known). The rationale skip is a document-structure rule (a 'II. Text of the Regulation' heading; today only GTR 9). The pair-merge 'keep the device regulation's copy' preference matches the dev observation that experts listed R148's lamp colours, not R48's. Prompts name no product or regulation, were written once and run once; dev and holdout-acpe were each judged once per variant as a guard (recall must not drop more than ~1 point). The marking re-split failed that guard and was not adopted
not_tuned: no threshold or size was swept; the ranker cut-off (drop rating 1) is inherited and fixed
LLM answers are shared with v2's cache (identical prompts reuse v2's answers); the regulation-pick answers and the bumper's new batches were generated fresh for v3
notes: v4 = v3 + skip_rationale + merge_pairs + subject check, all applied after the ranker on v3's cached output; regulation override used for the bumper (GTR 9, R10, R26, R42, R48, R127, R148, the set the user confirmed).
